ownerGovernedBehavior.childTestIsolation: Each test child receives a fixed seven-key environment rather than inherited parent values; DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH targets an asserted-absent controlled sentinel; an embedded data: ESM preload guard fail-closes global fetch, listed Node network/DNS surfaces, and listed node:fs .env read/open surfaces.
ownerGovernedBehavior.isolationScopeLimitation: The preload guard is an in-process monkeypatch of enumerated Node APIs, not a general operating-system sandbox or a full audit of every possible native/addon side channel.
